notes.title: Crash Test Oliver Goes Free to Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215251/a1f205dbefd7f90f8a63acf4c66f01630ca76a8b.jpg[/img]

We're excited to announce that Crash Test Oliver is now completely free to play! Starting today, everyone can jump into this stylized 2.5D metroidvania adventure without any cost or limitations.

Whether you're scaling through versatile environments, facing challenging obstacles, or discovering new paths in our interconnected world, the entire Crash Test Oliver experience is now open to all players. This isn't a limited-time offer – the game is permanently free to play.

New players: Welcome to our community! We can't wait to see you tackle the game's challenges and discover all the secrets hidden throughout the world.

Existing players: Thank you for your continued support. Your early belief in our game helped make this moment possible.

Download Crash Test Oliver now and begin your adventure. See you in the game!

notes.title: Crash Test Oliver Speedrun Challenge
notes.content:
[b]Your mission:[/b] Try to beat the best time of our game creator Philipp (Steam Name: Bonkey Dong) in the Crash Test Oliver Speedrun Challenge.

[b]Your Reward:[/b] If you manage to beat the best time, you will receive a free key for the full version of Crash Test Oliver game on Steam (*limited to one key per username).

[b]We give you a bonus:[/b] Philipp's best time is 2:23.3 (2 minutes, 23.3 seconds). But he gives you a 6.7 second advantage. So you only need to beat the 2:30 time to get your free key.

[b]How to participate:[/b] Click on the banner "Download Crash Test Oliver Speedrun Challenge" at our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936860/Crash_Test_Oliver/]Steam Page.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215251/dd46462793d7a92855bb55897232b36394b9be41.png[/img]

*This promotion will end on Monday, 10. July 2023 or after 100 key winners (whichever comes first).

[b]A little help:[/b] Check out YouTube to see how Philipp did it.

[previewyoutube=ky1fPNl8oak;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Oliver 1.0
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

After 4 years of dedication, passion and hard work, we are thrilled to announce the official launch of Oliver! A big thank you to those who have supported us during the Early Access phase by buying or wishlisting the game, as well as providing feedback and engaging with us on social media. We are excited to see new players join the adventure and cannot wait to hear your thoughts!

To engage with us (the developers) or the community join our [url=https://discord.gg/XfeTXs8KgZ]Discord Channel[/url]!

notes.title: Military Base Update - Now Available!
notes.content:
New area added - You now have access to a large new area on the map: Military Base!

This highly secured army outpost is said to be almost impossible to infiltrate. But at its heart are two fuels so you have no choice but to try and get them. He'll need to survive guard dogs, self-firing machineguns, electric fences, watchtowers and many other dangers. But there's an awesome new ability at your disposal: you can walk in 3D in many areas now!
 
There will be another update for this area soon giving access to even more challenges!
 
We've put a lot of hard work and passion into designing this area and improving the existing ones. We think you'll love the new stuff and improvements and are excited for feedback!


[previewyoutube=si9wopdIVR8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Switch between 2D & 3D
notes.content:
Good news for Oliver: now he can also move in 3D. We have made a fundamental update for the next release, Military Base. In some areas, you will be able to switch to 3D mode. The Military Base release is planned for the end of October.
